deployments_detail.use: AI quality inspection with unified cross-facility data management; 46,000+ sqm intelligent factory (NOTE: internal use, distinct from AI-vision solutions they sell)

AI Camera for industrial machine vision — positioning, measurement, recognition and defect detection, built on the Qualcomm QCM6490 platform with an in-house 'AI Creator' visual model training platform supporting rapid sample training, one-click model conversion and on-device deployment [Sunny Optical Intelligence Technology (Sunny OIT); Qualcomm QCM6490 platform]

2K AI Recognition Module — embedded AI algorithms for pose, gesture and face recognition, deployed in smart TVs, PTZ cameras, fitness mirrors and video-call devices [Sunny Optical Intelligence Technology (Sunny OIT)]

3D linear structured-light / ToF vision sensors for robot obstacle avoidance and navigation, deployed in Roborock robot vacuum cleaners [Sunny Optical Intelligence Technology (Sunny OIT); customer: Roborock]

ToF navigation vision solution deployed in Yeedi (Ecovacs sub-brand) KK-series robot vacuum cleaners for AI-based navigation and obstacle avoidance [Sunny Optical Intelligence Technology (Sunny OIT); customer: Yeedi / Ecovacs]

6DoF SLAM spatial localization & mapping module for head-and-hand tracking, deployed in the DPVR E4 gaming VR headset with millimeter-level controller accuracy [Sunny Optical Intelligence Technology (Sunny OIT); customer: DPVR]
TOF-based RGB-D depth sensor for edge-AI robotics, deployed on the D-Robotics Sunrise X3 Pi developer board [Sunny Optical Intelligence Technology (Sunny OIT); customer: D-Robotics]

Full-stack self-developed robot vision system (in-house processor, hardware, embedded software, multimodal AI algorithms and optics) that recognizes high/low-reflectance surfaces, outdoor glare, tiny objects and semi-transparent targets; deployed at scale with numerous vacuum-robot, commercial-robot and lawn-mowing-robot brands (mass production) [Sunny Optical Intelligence Technology (Sunny OIT)]
Stereo-camera modules with AI face and palm-vein/palm-print recognition — C300 for smart locks and HSP003A for retail biometric payment [Sunny Optical Intelligence Technology (Sunny OIT)]

New-generation AI glasses combining free-form/diffractive waveguide lenses, micro-display and sensing modules with on-device AI for virtual-real interaction and an intelligent assistant; debuted at CES 2026 [Sunny Optical Technology (Group)]

Automotive AI vision — driver/occupant monitoring systems (DMS/OMS), LiDAR transmitter/receiver optics and HUD modules forming a perception-interaction-display closed loop for L2+ toward higher-level autonomous driving and in-cabin interaction [Sunny Optical Technology (Group)]

Embodied-intelligence robot vision for humanoid, commercial and lawn-mowing robots — environmental perception, navigation/obstacle avoidance, hand-eye coordination, spatial positioning and target recognition, plus embodied-AI data-collection terminals; showcased at FAIR plus 2026 [Sunny Optical Intelligence Technology (Sunny OIT)]
